description: Low-confidence topic test — confidence < 0.5. Expect topic_drift_warning + qc_warnings + human_review_required regardless of Lever.

topic_signal.topic: Random meme template trending on TikTok this week
topic_signal.reason: Trend Hunter low-confidence ping; format unclear; may not align with REINVENTED voice
